body.name: FrontierHandle
body.def: Use the unconditional cubic-elimination upper bound first. For the lower direction, admit only acyclic indegree-two families with at least as many missing bidirected pairs as directed edges, prove generic birationality before any degree argument, compute exact closures over all structural and disturbance coordinates, and audit the three graphical criteria. The old two-parent windmills are retained only as a dimension-screen counterexample, while \(K_6\) supplies the exact finite calibration.
